summary: Globant S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on April 28, 2026. The filing states that shareholders approved all matters submitted, which were previously disclosed in a March 27, 2026 Form 6-K. This is a routine corporate governance event with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns. The filing incorporates the report into several registration statements. The document is a standard foreign private issuer report and does not signal any transformative corporate action or unusual event.
